Maybe you'll even get guts and all!|audio = Null&VoidN2Wave17-2.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 17 ([[Banlands]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Electroshocker''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Electroshocker''', was an enemy that appears in [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and fast speed. When killed, it will press a button that will fire lightning at towers, causing it to hit up to 5 towers and units in its explosion range of 15. This will stun towers for 5 seconds and deal 1,000 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Electroshocker emerged crackling with purple energy, voltage surging through his body. He trembled with power, storing massive quantities of it within his body as he prepared to release a destructive burst. Electroshocker's eyes narrowed. Disgusting.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Electroshocker''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Electroshocker]]. It wears black full body armor with a helmet that has a blue visor, and grey knee-pads. Large parts of its body are covered in purple goo that has blue veins going over it. On its back, it has a giant tesla coil which it uses to unleash lightning at towers and units. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] can reliably take multiple of them down due to their mediocre health for where they spawn. *As they spawn in groups, AOE towers like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are extremely effective. *Its recommended to not put towers near the path to lessen the chance of your towers getting stunned by the '''Null Electroshocker''' death ability. **Similarly, high range towers are also helpful as the ability can only stun towers in a specific range, which is easier to not be in if the tower has high range. *Unstunnable towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be used to take them out safely and at a long range before they can reach your ground units. *It is possible to prevent towers from getting stunned in various ways. **The most reliable method would be choosing the [[Temperance]] curse, as it gives every tower stun immunity. Do note however that it comes with [[Mutation]], which severity entirely depends on the wave it was activated on. **The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned while it is active. However, do note that '''Null Electroshockers''' spawn in hordes, meaning it is likely for them to hit one tower more than once. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullElectroshockerWalkAnimation.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullElectroshockerDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullElec.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Night2Promo.png|'''Null Electroshocker''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Null&VoidNight2PII.png|'''Null Electroshocker''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Electroshocker''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullElectroshockerIconIG.png|'''Null Electroshocker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *While its appearance mostly resembles the Level 5 default skin for the [[Electroshocker]], the tesla coil on its back is very similar to the tesla coil used by the {{Color|Deluxe|Classic}} [[Electroshocker]] skin. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **'''Null Electroshocker''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Electroshocker''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Null Electroshocker''' has a broken death animation. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Electroshocker's''' death animation now works. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Electroshocker''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Electroshocker''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''25 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0|v2.11.2]] **'''Null Electroshocker''' re-added to the main game in the [[Nil Zone II]] as part of the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. {{Banlands|[[Null Medic]]|Wave 15|Null Electroshocker & [[Null Beast]]|Wave 17|[[Null Warden]]|Wave 18}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Pursuit]]|Wave 15|Null Electroshocker|Wave 16|[[Null Medic]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
